programme.desc: Situé en 2068, Captain Scarlet suit la "guerre psychologique" entre la Terre et les Mysterons, une race martienne qui possède un contrôle partiel sur la matière. Lorsqu'un malentendu pousse des astronautes humains à attaquer leur ville sur Mars, les Mysterons jurent de se venger et lancent une série de représailles contre la Terre.

programme.title: Executive Protection
programme.desc: Max Webber, ex-forces spéciales et protection d'élite rapprochée, a consacré sa vie et sa carrière à protéger les autres. Travaillant pour l'un des hommes les plus riches du monde, Max, se retrouve impliqué dans un complot de trahison qui a traversé le monde et menace de lui coûter tout.

programme.title: Mercenarios de élite
programme.desc: Un equipo de letales mercenarios son contratados estratégicamente por el multimillonario CEO de tecnología Donovan Chalmers (Bruce Willis) para proteger una pieza de tecnología que, si se expone, podría destruir el mundo. Su misión se convierte en un riesgo aún mayor cuando la hija de Chalmers es secuestrada por el peligroso grupo terrorista The Pardoners.

programme.title: Linea del Condado
programme.desc: Cuando su amigo es aesinado, el ex sherif se enfrenta a una red delictiva mientras investiga el asesinato que parece ser parte de la red.

programme.title: Terror no Ar
programme.desc: Quando o para-brisa do jato comercial se estilhaça a 30.000 pés de altura, um piloto e sua tripulação trabalham para garantir a segurança dos passageiros e pousar o avião.

programme.title: Stalingrad Sniper
programme.desc: Le commandant Yashin est envoyé près de Minsk, où il découvre la trace de potentiels missiles au sein de la ville. Le temps presse alors pour les retrouver, d'autant que de mystérieux snipers abattent ceux qui restent à découvert...

programme.title: El Hechicero Y La Serpiente Blanca
programme.desc: Un monje maestro intenta proteger a un joven e ingenuo médico de un demonio serpiente milenario. Una competencia de poderes psíquicos desata el caos.

programme.title: El Último Guerrero
programme.desc: Son tiempos en que una civilización está reemplazando a otra. Está por comenzar una nueva era en Eurasia Central. Los escitas, los orgullosos guerreros, ya se han ido.

programme.title: A Invasão
programme.desc: Depois que sua pequena cidade australiana é aniquilada por um ataque aéreo avassalador, um grupo de civis foge da captura e descobre que agora estão entre os últimos sobreviventes de uma invasão extraterrestre que engolfou todo o planeta. Enquanto a humanidade cai sob ocupação mundial, eles formam um exército local para lutar contra forças inimigas muito superiores. Na linha de frente da batalha pela Terra, eles são nossa última esperança.

programme.title: Stalingrad Sniper
programme.desc: Le commandant Yashin est envoyé près de Minsk, où il découvre la trace de potentiels missiles au sein de la ville. Le temps presse alors pour les retrouver, d'autant que de mystérieux snipers abattent ceux qui restent à découvert...

programme.title: The Reunion
programme.desc: Después de la muerte de su padre, son reunidos tres hermanos. Sam, un policía en suspensión; Leo, un fiador judicial; y Douglas, un guapo ladrón de veinte años.

programme.title: Imparable
programme.desc: Dong-Chul fue un gánster legendario, pero está intentando llevar una vida honesta y pacífica dentro de la legalidad. Sin embargo, todo cambia cuando su esposa, Ji-soo, es secuestrada por una banda de tráfico de mujeres. Así que Dong-Chul no verá otra salida que volver a sus antiguos métodos para poder encontrarla.

programme.title: 6 Balas
programme.desc: Quando a filha de um lutador de MMA é sequestrada, há somente um homem que pode ajudar a encontrá-la – um notório ex-mercenário, cujo boatos, levou seis tiros no peito.

programme.title: Le Voyage Fantastique: Des Freres Bodganov
programme.desc: Une série innovante qui éclaire des sujets captivants : 1- Sommes-nous seuls dans l'univers? Explorez la possibilité de communiquer avec d'autres mondes. 2- Risques cosmiques : Les rayons gamma, les supervolcans et les inversions des pôles magnétiques peuvent-ils détruire la Terre? 3- Le côté caché du cerveau: Nouvelles théories basées sur des individus uniques avec une puissance cérébrale incroyable.

programme.title: La Invasión
programme.desc: Algunos residentes de la ciudad tienen que unirse después de una devastadora invasión alienígena. Mientras luchan por sobrevivir, se dan cuenta de que deben ir un paso por delante de sus atacantes y trabajar juntos para tener la oportunidad de contraatacar.

programme.title: Walt Avant Mickey
programme.desc: L'histoire vraie d'un garçon dont les rêves ont bâti un royaume. Le légendaire Walt Disney a eu une enfance tumultueuse, mais il était déterminé à surmonter les obstacles sur son chemin, avant la création de son premier personnage emblématique : Mickey Mouse.

programme.title: Looking for Sunshine
programme.desc: Un año en la vida de Lara Gut, desde su victoria en el título general de la Copa del Mundo de Esquí Alpino en 2016 hasta su regreso después de una lesión que amenazó su carrera. Este documental sigue el viaje de una campeona para equilibrar el autodescubrimiento y las expectativas públicas, una historia de superar desafíos y perseguir lo que amas.

programme.title: Os Mais Jovens
programme.desc: Um garoto de 14 anos (Kodi Smit-McPhee) é forçado a usar sua inteligência para sobreviver em um mundo pós-apocalíptico onde a água se tornou o recurso mais precioso, causando guerras violentas por sua posse.

programme.title: 6 Balas
programme.desc: Cuando secuestran a la hija de un profesional de artes marciales, sólo hay un hombre que puede ayudar a encontrarla: un ex-mercenario que se rumorea que una vez le llevó seis balas al pecho.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Situé en 2068, Captain Scarlet suit la "guerre psychologique" entre la Terre et les Mysterons, une race martienne qui possède un contrôle partiel sur la matière. Lorsqu'un malentendu pousse des astronautes humains à attaquer leur ville sur Mars, les Mysterons jurent de se venger et lancent une série de représailles contre la Terre.

programme.title: O Estrangeiro
programme.desc: A trama gira em torno do empreiteiro militar britânico Lex Walker, que é informado da morte de sua filha. Ao chegar em Los Angeles e descobrir que o corpo não é o dela, ele inicia uma investigação.

programme.title: Outra Vida
programme.desc: Uma cientista desenvolve uma droga revolucionária que induz realidades virtuais e expande a sensação de tempo. Quando o governo tenta assumir projeto, ela precisará decidir como usar sua poderosa criação.

programme.title: A Busca Pela Justiça
programme.desc: Em 1933, o bem-sucedido advogado nova-iorquino Sam Leibowitz viaja para o Sul dos Estados Unidos para defender nove jovens negros acusados ​​de estuprar duas mulheres em um trem de carga no Alabama. Na primavera de 1931, nove vagabundos negros foram retirados de um trem de carga no Alabama e presos sob a acusação de estuprar duas jovens brancas em um vagão de carga.

programme.title: Condução Perigosa
programme.desc: Peter Roberts (Thomas Jane), um ex-piloto de corrida automotiva, tornou-se instrutor de motorista e durante uma de suas aulas é sequestrado por Simon Keller (John Cusack), que supostamente seria um aluno como qualquer outro. O sequestrador misterioso força ele a participar de um crime que coloca ambos na mira da polícia e da máfia, desencadeando uma perseguição.

programme.title: O Último Guarda-Costas
programme.desc: Após ser libertado da prisão, um criminoso do sul de Londres tenta esquecer seu passado e mudar de vida; ele então se torna o protetor de uma jovem atriz que enfrenta alguns problemas.

programme.title: A Hora do Acerto
programme.desc: Para a Gangue dos 5, tudo é um videogame: matar policiais, armar emboscadas e criar requintes de crueldade. Quem se torna vítima de suas armadilhas é o inspetor de polícia Wing e todo o seu time de policiais, que são brutalmente assassinados. Após a matança, um jovem novato cheio de energia é designado para ajudálo, mas a Gangue dos 5 volta a agir, iniciando uma aventura cheia de ação e vingança.

programme.title: A Fronteira
programme.desc: Uma repórter americana busca seu irmão desaparecido em meio à violência e ao tráfico de pessoas na fronteira entre os Estados Unidos e o México.

programme.title: Código de Honra
programme.desc: Quando sua família é assassinada, um agente das Forças Especiais se torna um justiceiro. Será que seu antigo protegido, agora agente do FBI, conseguirá detê-lo antes que mafiosos e a polícia o capturem?

programme.title: Apenas Por Uma Noite
programme.desc: O marido de uma mulher casada e com uma vida perfeita trai a irmã, com consequências extremas para todos.

programme.desc: Depois de uma crítica negativa e uma palestra do chef Gordon Ramsay, um talentoso mas angustiado chef londrino transforma um pub country em um restaurante gourmet.

programme.desc: Um adolescente de Mumbai reflete sobre sua vida depois de ser acusado de enganar a versão indiana de "Quem quer ser um milionário?"

programme.title: Carol
programme.desc: Duas mulheres de origens diferentes começam uma relação na década de 1950. Carol é casada, mas seu casamento está morto há muito tempo. Ela quer um divórcio, mas o marido está tentando desesperadamente manter as aparências. Quando Carol (Cate Blanchett) e Teresa (Mia Wasikowska) se apaixonam, o marido de Carol inicia o processo para obter a custódia total de seu filho. Seu marido tenta usar a homosexualidade de Carol no tribunal contra ela e lhe proíbe de ver sua filha por pelo menos 3 meses em uma tentativa de vingança

programme.desc: O jovem Jack é um dos três irmãos que cresceram como parte da família O'Brien em uma pequena cidade do Texas. Jack tem um relacionamento controverso com seu pai, mas se dá bem com sua bela mãe. Como adulto, Jack luta com seu passado e tenta dar sentido à sua infância, ao mesmo tempo em que se debate com questões existenciais maiores.

programme.title: Enquanto Estivermos Juntos
programme.desc: Um professor universitário alcoólatra em recuperação conhece uma nova aluna sedutora. Ela oferece a ele uma fuga sensual da realidade até que ele perceba que ela pode ser louca.

programme.title: Luck
programme.desc: Musa, an underworld kingpin and a firm believer in luck, designs a series of life threatening adventure sports with hefty prize money for people around the world. However, the participants can only survive and win if they are exceptionally lucky.

programme.title: Shatranj Ke Khilari
programme.desc: Set in 1856 this satirical film traces the fate of Awadh a kingdom ruled by Wajid Ali Shah and his team of disinterested governors. Two noblemen go a step further and devote themselves to endless rounds of chess while their kingdom gets annexed.

programme.title: Sau Din Saas Ke
programme.desc: Durga's mother-in-law is a callous and greedy taskmaster who runs her household in the strictest and controlling manner. To make life easier Durga must teach her mother-in-law a lesson in humility and also win her heart.

programme.title: Aankhen
programme.desc: When Vijay Singh Rajput is unceremoniously stripped of his duties as a bank manager, he decides to seek revenge by robbing the bank. To make the robbery untraceable, he trains three blind men to do the job for him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Alors que Liz et la Task Force mettent tout en œuvre pour empêcher un bombardement imminent, Red fait une rencontre qui changera à jamais sa vie.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Quand un associé du Nash Syndicat est assassiné, Red met Liz et la Task Force sur l'affaire afin de récupérer des preuves cruciales pour faire tomber Ian Garvey. Pendant ce temps, Aram envisage de faire un pas en avant dans sa relation avec Samar.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Dans une tentative d'exercer une pression sur Ian Garvey, Red et la Task Force se rendent à Paris pour traquer un important fournisseur d'héroïne pour le Syndicat Nash. Méfiante de l'agenda de Red, Liz prend son propre chemin en poursuivant Garvey.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz tente de découvrir les secrets que détient Red, tandis que ce dernier monte un plan pour récupérer le sac d'os.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: L'apparition mystérieuse d'une jeune fille inconnue lance Liz et la Task Force sur la piste de sa connexion avec le secret que cache Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Tandis que Red se représente lui-même au tribunal, il met Liz et la Task Force sur la piste d'un médecin hors-la-loi qui s'en prend à des patients désespérés.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red s'adapte à son nouvel environnement dans une prison fédérale, où il est défié par un vieux rival. Samar infiltre une organisation du marché noir qui finance des criminels. Pendant ce temps, Liz et Jennifer poursuivent leur enquête sur le passé de Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Alors que Red plaide devant les tribunaux pour maintenir son accord d'immunité, Liz et la Task Force interrogent un homme dont l'héritage récent semble trop beau pour être vrai.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red est envoyé dans un établissement médical fédéral à la suite de sa demande d'évaluation psychiatrique auprès du tribunal. Liz et Jennifer recherche une personne de la Blacklist qui, à leur avis, pourrait détenir de précieuses informations sur le passé de Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Alors que Red et Dembe sollicitent l'aide de Glen pour que le jury soit clément lors du procès de Red, la task force enquête sur une série de morts mystérieuses.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Alors que Liz et Jennifer recherchent une femme qui pourrait connaître un secret du passé de Red, elles se retrouvent menacées par un dangereux trafiquant. Pendant ce temps, Red joue le rôle de médiateur entre deux gangs rivaux en prison.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Tandis que Red se bat devant le tribunal pour blanchir son nom une fois pour toutes, Liz et la Task-Force enquêtent sur une personne de la Blacklist qui a la réputation de s'enrichir sur les secrets des autres.

programme.desc: La Task Force explore le monde non réglementé de la crypto-monnaie afin de déjouer une attaque imminente.

programme.title: Le Diable A Ma Porte
programme.desc: Une épouse et mère de deux enfants (Taraji P. Henson) mène une vie idéale qui connaît un virage soudain lorsque sa famille est menacée par un inconnu (Idris Elba), qui se fait inviter dans sa maison en prétendant avoir un problème avec sa voiture. Cette invitation inattendue la laisse terrorisée et la force à lutter pour sa survie.

programme.title: Middleman
programme.desc: Trois intrigues convergentes racontent l’histoire de contrebandiers, d'un tueur en série et de trafiquants de drogue. Un ancien trafiquant (Snipes) essaie de se ranger mais il tombe sur une cachette contenant des drogues volées. Dans le même temps, une banlieusarde d’âge moyen (Cybill Shepherd) cache un tempérament sadique et vicieux.

programme.title: Nightmare Island
programme.desc: Dans NIGHTMARE ISLAND (Blumhouse), l’énigmatique M. Roarke (Michael Peña) donne vie aux rêves de ses clients dans un complexe hôtelier luxurieux et isolé. Mais quand leurs fantasmes les plus fous se transforment en véritables cauchemars, les invités n’ont d’autre choix que de résoudre les mystères de cette île pour espérer en sortir vivants…

programme.title: Les Larmes Du Soleil
programme.desc: Au Nigéria, la famille du Président vient d'être assassinée et une guerre civile est sur le point d'éclater. Un commando secret mené par le lieutenant Waters est envoyé aux confins de la jungle afin de faire évacuer Lena Kendriks, une femme médecin travaillant pour une organisation humanitaire, d'un village menacé par les rebelles. Mais le cours de la mission change lorsque celle-ci refuse de partir sans les villageois...

programme.title: The Patriot
programme.desc: Caroline du Sud, 1776. Le conflit entre les independantistes et les Anglais semble inevitable. Benjamin Martin sait trop bien ce qu'est une guerre et il n'en veut pas. Cet ancien heros des combats contre les Francais et les Indiens n'ignore rien de la violence des affrontements armes... Aujourd'hui veuf, il eleve seul ses sept enfants dans sa plantation.

programme.title: Spider-Man : New Generation
programme.desc: Spider-Man traverse les dimensions et fait équipe avec ses autres versions.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: L'histoire de la naissance du personnage le plus énigmatique, complexe et badass de l'univers Marvel : VENOM ! Après avoir tout perdu, notamment sa femme et son travail, Eddy Brock (Tom Hardy) est un homme complètement abattu. Alors qu'il est au plus bas, il devient l'hôte d'un symbiote alien qui lui confère d'extraordinaires superpouvoirs et le transforme progressivement en Venom... Mais ces nouveaux pouvoirs ne vont peut être pas suffire face au redoutable Riot, un autre symbiote bien plus puissant et armé que lui…

programme.title: The Spirit
programme.desc: Denny Colt, un ancien flic, revient mystérieusement d'entre les morts. Il est désormais le Spirit, combattant du crime dans les rues obscures de Central City. Son ennemi juré, Octopus, a un but bien différent : dans sa folle quête d'immortalité, il s'apprête à détruire la ville. Aux quatre coins de la cité, le Spirit traque le tueur. Sur son chemin, le héros masqué croise des femmes, toutes sublimes, qui cherchent à le séduire, l'aimer ou le tuer... Seul son amour de toujours ne le trahira pas : Central City, la ville qui l'a vu naître... deux fois.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: Né dans les flammes de l'enfer, le démon Hellboy est transporté sur Terre lors d'une sombre cérémonie célébrée par les nazis, désireux d'utiliser les forces infernales à des fins de conquête. Sauvé par le docteur Broom, Hellboy est alors élevé pour combattre les forces du Mal.

programme.title: The Punisher
programme.desc: Ancien membre de la Delta Force, puis agent spécial au FBI, Frank Castle s'apprête à se retirer pour mener une existence paisible auprès de sa femme et de son jeune fils. Lors de son ultime mission, les choses tournent mal et le fils de Howard Saint, puissant businessman et magnat de la pègre, est tué. Ivre de vengeance, Saint organise le massacre de Frank et de toute sa famille.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: L'histoire de la naissance du personnage le plus énigmatique, complexe et badass de l'univers Marvel : VENOM ! Après avoir tout perdu, notamment sa femme et son travail, Eddy Brock (Tom Hardy) est un homme complètement abattu. Alors qu'il est au plus bas, il devient l'hôte d'un symbiote alien qui lui confère d'extraordinaires superpouvoirs et le transforme progressivement en Venom... Mais ces nouveaux pouvoirs ne vont peut être pas suffire face au redoutable Riot, un autre symbiote bien plus puissant et armé que lui…

programme.title: Starship Troopers 2: Hero Of The Federation
programme.desc: Un petit groupe de soldats trouve refuge dans un avant-poste abandonné alors qu’ils combattent les envahissants arachnides. Ils ne se rendent pas compte qu'un danger bien plus grave menace leur unité.

programme.title: Supergrave
programme.desc: Evan et Seth sont deux amis pas très futés qui ne peuvent pas se passer l'un de l'autre. Pourtant, il va bien falloir qu'ils apprennent, parce que cette année, ils sont inscrits dans deux universités différentes ! Evan est craquant, plutôt intelligent et constamment terrifié par la vie - et les filles en particulier.

programme.title: Easy Girl
programme.desc: Après avoir menti en prétendant avoir perdu sa virginité, une jeune lycéenne très soignée fait l'objet d'accusations comparables à celles portées à Hester Prynne dans The Scarlet Letter, roman qu’elle est en train d’étudier à l’école. Elle décide de se servir de cette rumeur pour améliorer sa situation sociale et financière.

programme.title: Animal L'animal
programme.desc: Marvin est un véritable loser et le bouc émissaire de ses collègues policiers. Après avoir été victime d'un terrible accident de voiture, il est soigné par un savant qui lui greffe des organes d'animaux : si cela lui permet de sentir la drogue et de sauver le fils du maire de la noyade, il lui est de plus en plus difficile de se contrôler.

programme.title: Jack and Jill
programme.desc: Jack Sadelstein, un brillant directeur d’agence publicitaire de Los Angeles, marié à une jolie femme et père de famille, redoute chaque année le même événement : la visite de sa sœur jumelle, Jill, pour Thanksgiving. L’indigence et l’agressivité passive de Jill exaspèrent Jack et bouleversent sa vie.

programme.title: Self Control
programme.desc: Dave Buznik est un homme calme et doux qui n'aime pas les situations conflictuelles jusqu'au jour où, à la suite d'une altercation dans un avion, et malgré lui, il se trouve dans l'obligation de suivre une thérapie supposée contrôler sa colère.

programme.title: Les aventures de Mister Deeds
programme.desc: Vivant dans une petite ville provinciale, Longfellow Deeds (SANDLER) se rend dans une grande ville pour y recevoir un héritage de 40 milliards de dollars, venant d’un oncle qu’il avait perdu de vue. Vivre dans un palais, avec les services d’un valet personnel inhabituel (JOHN TURTURRO) n’est pas si mal. Les choses vont de mieux en mieux quand il rencontre une belle infirmière scolaire (WINONA RYDER). Mais l’argent change tout et rien n’est ce que ça paraît. Sa chérie est en fait une journaliste qui rapporte ses écarts scandaleux à la presse ! Il appartiendra à Deeds de remettre tout le monde dans le droit chemin, avec quelques crochets du droit et beaucoup de bon sens.

programme.title: Mange Prie Aime
programme.desc: Elizabeth Gilbert, auteure new-yorkaise de 28 ans, a tout pour être heureuse : un mari, un grand appartement… Mais un jour, elle se rend compte qu'elle ne retrouve plus dans sa vie, qu'elle est vide d'émotion, qu'elle a perdu son appétit de la vie. Après un divorce douloureux, puis une relation insatisfaisante avec un jeune acteur, elle entreprend un voyage d'un an d'abord à Rome, puis dans un ashram en Inde et enfin à Bali.

programme.title: Spanglish
programme.desc: John Clasky (Adam Sandler) est un père dévoué dont les talents de chef ont permis à sa famille (Téa Leoni, Cloris Leachman) de vivre une vie de luxe. Ils possèdent une villa d'été à Malibu, dont s'occupe la magnifique gouvernante, Flor (Paz Vega), qui a quitté le Mexique pour immigrer à Los Angeles afin d'offrir une meilleure vie à sa remarquable fille, Cristina (Shelbie Bruce), qui embrasse très vite ce nouveau style de vie américain.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Riche, beau et célèbre, Jerry Maguire, agent des stars du sport americain, l'est. Mais sa vie mondaine et factice lui pèse, et une nuit il se remet en question dans une note qu'il rédige, où il tente de définir le sens qu'il voudrait donner à sa vie. Cette note va provoquer son licenciement et tous ses amis vont le trahir.

programme.title: Chevalier
programme.desc: Bien qu'il ne soit pas noble et donc qu'il n'ait pas le droit de participer aux joutes des chevaliers, l'intrépide William décide de prendre son destin en main en remplaçant au pied levé le seigneur dont il est l'écuyer, décédé tragiquement quelques jours avant le fameux tournoi qui doit réunir tous les chevaliers du territoire.

programme.title: The Ugly Truth
programme.desc: Ambitieuse productrice de talk-show, Abby Richter se targue de pouvoir trouver instantanément une solution à n'importe quel problème. Le seul qu'elle n'a pas réussi à résoudre, c'est son célibat. Lorsque le taux d'audience de son émission faiblit, Abby est obligée d'engager un nouvel animateur soi-disant expert en relations humaines, Mike Chadway. Dans l'émission, celui-ci traite de ce qui plaît vraiment aux hommes. Le choc est rude entre la jeune femme et ce provocateur odieux et macho. Le pire, c'est qu'il fait grimper l'audience et devient incontournable...

programme.title: Crise De Mères
programme.desc: Tout ce que Allyson et ses amies veulent, c'est de passer une soirée entre filles, et jaser autour d'une table... une pause bien méritée pour les mamans. Pour apprécier leurs talons aiguilles, la discussion d'adultes et le repas servi au restaurant, leurs époux doivent garder les enfants durant trois heures — ça semble pourtant simple.

programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. programme.desc: Ray uncovers the infamous “Brawner Hawk” – from the Dean Van Lines team – that became the breakout car in the career of Mario Andretti. programme.title: AmeriCarna

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the late 60s, Camaros, Mustangs, and Corvettes roared to the forefront of the muscle car world. But because it is a pro-am race, Ray pulls in a partner – none other than Bill Elliott, aka “Awesome Bill from Dawsonville.”

programme.title: AmeriCarna

programme.title: Fly Shop Tour
programme.desc: Welcome to The Fly Shop Tour! In September of 2022, we set across the Rocky Mountains on a 2500 Mile Road Trip visiting & fishing with local Fly Shops. Our Mission? To highlight small businesses that drive the sport we love: Fly Fishing! Along the way, we got a chance to host meetups in every state - all with the goal to raise money for local conservation organizations & meet some of our fans. Follow us as we tell the story of 12 unique fly shops, fish the waters surrounding their area, and make our way throughout the Rocky Mountains.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.sub-title: "Opening Week in Mississippi started off with a BANG!!"
programme.desc: Opening day in Mississippi has arrived and Slade is taking full advantage of it! With the weather not cooperating Slade and Zeb stumble into a turkey hunt they won't soon forget. Two days later, the hot streak continues with Slade connecting on another turkey on an 83 acre property he has for sale! Also, Slade gives some tips and his ideas on small acreage hunting, and how it can be just as lucrative as big tracks of land!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and his son take on the turkey woods for an afternoon hunt. Lastly, Slade introduces a property that we have already made a video on, but with just how amazing the land is, we had to include it! Floweree is the epitome of a sportsman's paradise!

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We join Blake Barnett alongside hunter Jimmy Reynolds as they take part in the 2nd Annual Pierce Dutton Memorial Hunt. This meaningful whitetail hunt is made possible by the great folks at Disabled Outdoorsmen. Jimmy settles in at the G2 Ranch in South Texas, where prime whitetail country and a shared passion for the outdoors set the stage for an unforgettable hunt.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: In 2010, Amberly Snyder’s life changed forever when an accident left her paralyzed from the waist-down. Her comeback story not unlike something you’d see in a movie…in fact it inspired one. Disabled Outdoorsmen USA contacted TTHA and set up this hunt and we were fortunate enough to be able to capture just some of Amberly’s story and her harvest of a beautiful Axis buck at the G2 Ranch in the spring of 2022.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: With over 20 years of service, retiring as a Senior Chief Machinery Technician, Steven served abord multiple Coast Guard cutters, led critical missions, protected our nation's leaders, and earned the Coast Guard Achievement Medal for his outstanding service. Beyond the uniform, Steven has has spent decades giving back - coaching youth sports, mentoring young athletes, and living the values of service, leadership, and integrity. Steven's dedication didn't end with retirement - and neither does our gratitude. We were honored to have Steven at Thumbtack Ranch and are even more grateful for his service.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: From time to time you have moments that will change the way think about something. That is what happened for us while hunting the Scimitar Oryx with Republic Outdoors. Hunting is more than harvesting animals, it’s conservation, and in this story, we learn how a species nearly extinct gets another chance to live.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy and Cody are back on the Raven in Missouri and with opening day of bow season fast approaching they are scrambling to get all the final prep work done and correct any mistakes they might have made along the way.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy is getting the last food plot of the season in down at the Dirty Bird in Oklahoma. Then opening day of the 2025 bow season starts off in an unusual way for the crew. Randy smokes a Hog and Nate Has a really close call with one of the target bucks.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy and Cody are wrapping things up on the Raven before bow season arrives in Missouri. Planting I-70 the plot where Randy killed one of his biggest Missouri bucks ever last year. programme.title: The Raven Project

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors

We tag along on an Ice Fishing outing, a turkey hunt and a Women's Veterans retreat as we highlight this great organization and the heroes they serve. We also highlight Des Moine Iowa SCHEELS hometown hero, Navy Veteran Steve Booth!

programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Into The Blue

programme.title: Into The Blue
programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve catch Bonitas for bait and slow troll them around wrecks for Wahoo and Kingfish.

programme.desc: Phillip Culpepper gets some trigger time in Maryland. He hopes to tag his first Maryland longbeard. Culpepper also calls in a hen and she puts on a show. Follow along as the action unfolds.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson sets his sights on a Free-Range New Zealand Red Stag, but it doesn't come easy. Dense fog, steep terrain, and thick vegetation make finding a mature stag no easy task. Watch as Mark Peterson and his guide cover the gorgeous New Zealand landscape in search of one of the most sought-after big game animals on the South Island of New - Zealand. On this hunt, Mark was unable to get his firearms import permit in time to take his Gunwerks rifle, so he'd again have to borrow from his guide.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Northern Cape of South Africa: Axis and Fallow Deer"
programme.desc: Through the rugged terrain of South Africa's Northern Cape, Mark Peterson sets out in pursuit of a rare and thrilling double, the Axis and Fallow Deer. Though non-native, these species have flourished in the region's diverse habitat. Join Mark on this unforgettable experience under the African skies, during this unique hunting experience in South Africa.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: When Justin and Meredith stay positive after a series of bad breaks, it pays off in fun. If fun means fish. After all, we are in Panama City Beach.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Illinois isn’t the first state you think about when it comes to waterfowl, but the Wentz Brothers have dialed in some honey holes over the years. On this episode, a slew of waterfowl experts put to the test some of the newest Winchester waterfowl ammunition during the great migration of the Mississippi Flyway in early December. We’ll also head north to the shores of Kodiak Island, Alaska with Chris and Casey Keefer as they push the limits of Winchester’s new Last Call Double Shot on fast-ripping sea ducks. - GUESTS: Zach Wentz (Team Winchester) Nathan Robinson (Winchester Ammunition) Ryan Swaner (Winchester Repeating Arms) Chris Jennings (Ducks Unlimited) Mike Brasher (Ducks Unlimited) Scott Olmsted (American Hunter) Travis Hall (Field & Stream) Chris Keefer (Team Winchester) Casey Keefer (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Col. Nick Nichols from Folds of Honor and Olympic skeet shooter Dania Vizzi are both proud Americans who have represented their country overseas. Col. Nichols commanded the air in the cockpit of a fighter jet for countless missions during his seven combat tours and Dania donned the stars and bars proudly on her shooting vest as an Olympian in Paris. Now with Winchesters in hand, both are in the Midwest whitetail woods during late November during the back end of the rut hoping to connect on a Missouri monarch.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Across the country, deer season to many Americans is a rite of passage. For generations, Winchester has been the trusted ammunition choice for hunters…and it’s been a decade since the game-changing Deer Season XP whitetail line was introduced. In this episode, we’ll celebrate the many successes by Team Winchester hunters in the field during whitetail and mule deer firearm seasons across the United States. - GUESTS: Melissa Bachman (Team Winchester) Mark Drury (Team Winchester) Nikki Boxler (Team Winchester) Chris Keefer (Team Winchester) Casey Keefer (Team Winchester) Jason Gilbertson (Team Winchester)

He travels on mountain bike, steam train and Cessna to experience the huge fires and meet the northern fire crews battling the blazes.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Mount Washington, New Hampshire has the dubious title of being home to the world’s worst weather. The highest wind ever recorded on the planet – 231 miles per hour – was recorded at its mountaintop observatory. To prepare for a mid-winter assault on the summit, Angry Planet host George Kourounis becomes a “human popsicle”, encased in ice in at the National Resarch Council’s high speed wind tunnel. Then he and his sidekick Mark Robinson climb to the top of the mountain in mid-January and brave their way into a summit blizzard.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Dominica, the most volcanic and mountainous island in the Caribbean, is home to the Boiling Lake, a large waterfall-fed lake of furiously boiling water. Adventurer George Kourounis becomes the first person ever to traverse across the lake on a rope, risking his life to take water samples and shoot video from a place no human has ever been. He then dives to the ocean floor off the coast of the island to explore vents where the superheated water bubbles into the ocean.
